Introducing the Prompt Airlines CTF: Test Your AI Security Skills
Wiz is excited to announce "Prompt Airlines," a new cloud security Capture The Flag (CTF) event focused on AI vulnerabilities.
Nir Ohfeld
July 24, 2024|
Put your AI security skills to the test
In this challenge, you'll interact with a chatbot acting as the customer service for the fictional Prompt Airlines. Your goal is to find and exploit vulnerabilities in the AI's logic to trick it into giving you a free flight ticket. The entire challenge is conducted through chatbot interaction - no coding or technical skills required!
Each stage of the challenge highlights a different AI security risk that could impact real businesses. It's a hands-on opportunity to learn about securing AI systems against malicious attacks.
Open to all skill levels
The Prompt Airlines CTF is open to all skill levels. No special tools needed - just your problem-solving abilities. Form a team with friends or colleagues to collaborate, but note that progress is tracked individually.
Claim your AI security certificate
All registered participants who complete the challenge will be featured on our leaderboard and receive an official certificate designed like a flight ticket, recognizing their AI security skills.
The top CTF finishers will also have a chance to win flight-related prizes from Wiz, such as suitcases, travel accessories, and more.
Ready to outsmart the AI?
Based on real AI vulnerabilities discovered by Wiz Research, the Prompt Airlines CTF offers a practical way to learn about AI security. Put your skills to the test and see if you can outsmart the AI.Start the Prompt Airlines Challenge!
The Prompt Airlines CTF Challenge was designed by the expert Wiz Research team. Questions or need assistance? Contact us at research@wiz.io or on X @wizresearch/@nirohfeld/@shirtamari.
